about: Errors in the text of a released version of the book or the solutions manual, as a reader would want to know them. book/tools/errata.py checks this file (ctest book.errata) and writes the errata page of the download page. A fix of the code, the build or the regulatory file is in the CHANGELOG, not here.

errata.text: The included listings began with a stray "};" and left out EventBuffer and ring384: their line ranges were stale.

errata.where: How to use this book, installing the tools
errata.text: The apt line lacked python3-scipy and python3-matplotlib, so the test system.e2e failed on a new reader's first ctest run. Add both packages to the install line.

With mlockall(MCL_CURRENT | MCL_FUTURE) in force, a new thread's stack is resident from the start (measured: 0 page faults over 512 KiB); the text said its pages still fault. What still faults is the main thread's growing stack, and everything when the lock is refused, which is why the stages prefault anyway. The mistakes box and the solutions' answer 8 change with it.
Class A is stated as Amendment 1 of IEC 62304 has it: the software cannot contribute to a hazardous situation, or it can but no unacceptable risk results after risk controls outside the software.

The worked example used P1 and P2 both for the standard's two probability factors and for two levels of the plan's probability scale in one paragraph. The factors keep P1 and P2; the levels are named by the scale.
Exercises 27.3, 28.3, 29.3, 30.1 and 30.2 were marked (S), which How to use this book does not define. They are easy exercises: (E).
